```{r, echo=F, message=F, warning=F, results=F}
library(rprojroot)
root <- rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()
source(file.path(root, "analysis/Rfunctions.R"))
root <- rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()
```




```{r, echo=F, message=F, warning=F}
data=as_tibble(read_xlsx(file.path(root, "..\\2026\\202606\\Ibrahim\\Pre and Post Clickers.xlsx" )),header=T)
```


```{r, message=F, warning=F}
summary(data$`Pre clickers/10`)
summary(data$`Post clickers/10`)
```


```{r, message=F, warning=F}
t.test(data$`Pre clickers/10`, data$`Post clickers/10`, paired = T)
```
* average grade, pre-clicker: 5.89, post clicker: 8.47

* the grades of post clicker is 2.57 higher than pre-clicker, with p value less than $10^{-16}$
